font-size="13">the Compose cluster</text></svg><figcaption id="mr-cap">MapReduce-Reloaded as built so far: mr submit sends a job to the coordinator, or mr run -local runs it in one process, which every other mode must match byte for byte. The coordinator keeps the task table, logs each decision to a write-ahead log, and tracks workers by heartbeat. Workers ask it for tasks over gRPC; map tasks write R partition files and serve them, and reduce tasks fetch their partition from every map task, sort, reduce and write one output file each. The coordinator serves a status page, the coordinator and every worker export Prometheus metrics, and an optional Grafana dashboard shows them. This drawing is the Go cluster path. It leaves out the host client, the VersityGW S3 profile, the Python coordinator and the benchmark harness, which are built.</figcaption></figure>
